name: vmware-debug
description: VMware diagnostic brain — offline incident triage, log/event correlation, and root-cause routing across the VMware skill family
long_description: Runs the published vmware-debug 2.4.0 MCP server locally. This extension starts with read-only tools (expose = read); set it to all to offer write tools, which stay governed by the shared policy and are recorded in the local audit log. Follow the setup guide for local state and the sibling skills it uses.

expose.title: Tools to offer
expose.description: read = read-only tools only (default); all = every tool, including writes.
